claim: Documentation catalog and inventory support only. No class has verified Max execution compatibility. Candidates identify research targets, not selected implementations or interchangeable semantics.

objects.ports: 1 message inlet; 1 bang outlet. Click or incoming message triggers bang.
objects.reference_gates: Message filters, ignoreclick, GUI activation versus message input.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 1 numeric/bang inlet; 1 integer outlet. Bang alternates state; incoming numbers are converted to integers and passed through, not universally normalized to 0/1.
objects.reference_gates: Nonzero values, negative values, float conversion and set without output.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Numeric/message input and value output; numeric format and attributes affect coercion. Preserve saved port declarations; no inferred auxiliary outlet behavior.
objects.reference_gates: Max version and format: current docs include Int/Float/List/Text modes; clipping and editing output.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Numeric input and floating-point value output. set changes stored/displayed value without output; saved ports retained.
objects.reference_gates: Precision, clipping, float conversion, keyboard/drag actions and auxiliary outlet behavior.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 2 inlets: left triggers stored message/substitution; right replaces contents silently. Message outlet may emit multiple messages.
objects.reference_gates: Dollar substitution, comma/semicolon syntax, escaping, selector/type preservation; never execute text during import.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 1 input; argument-defined typed outlets, emitted right-to-left. No args gives two integer outlets.
objects.reference_gates: Types i/f/b/l/s, constants, list/anything coercion, synchronous depth-first fan-out.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Argument-defined inlets store list elements; left inlet emits list, other inlets update silently. 1 output.
objects.reference_gates: Typed defaults/coercion, lists across inlets, set, bang, nth/send extensions.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 1 list/message input; argument-defined typed element outlets. Outlet ordering remains a reference-test gate.
objects.reference_gates: Type conversion, short/long lists and selector handling. Capture actual outlet delivery order.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Match input emits bang on matching outlet; rightmost outlet emits unmatched input. Arguments determine match outlets; single integer/no argument adds cold comparison inlet.
objects.reference_gates: Mixed selector types, matchfloat/fuzzy, equality and rejection payload.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 1 input, selector-defined outlets plus unmatched outlet. Matching selector is removed for routed payload; unmatched messages retain content.
objects.reference_gates: Type selectors, bang and one-atom matches, int/float/anything distinctions.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 2 numeric inlets; left computes/emits, right stores operand; 1 numeric output. Argument type controls integer/float behavior.
objects.reference_gates: Overflow, conversion, list/set/bang and arithmetic precision.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 2 numeric inlets; left subtracts stored right operand and emits; right stores silently. 1 numeric output.
objects.reference_gates: Operand direction, overflow, argument-controlled numeric type and list/set/bang.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 2 numeric inlets; left multiplies/emits, right stores operand; 1 numeric output.
objects.reference_gates: Argument-controlled numeric type, overflow, list/set/bang.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 2 numeric inlets; left dividend computes/emits, right stores divisor. Floating argument selects floating output; otherwise integer conversion applies.
objects.reference_gates: Zero division, truncation, overflow, float argument distinction; documentation URL div is not a proven class alias.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Left inlet starts/stops periodic bang output; right inlet supplies interval. 1 bang output.
objects.reference_gates: Initial tick, restart, time formats, transport, overdrive/audio interrupt settings and cancellation.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Left inlet schedules bang; right inlet sets delay. 1 bang output.
objects.reference_gates: Retrigger, stop, simultaneous deadlines, time formats and scheduler priority.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Argument-defined typed value inlets/outlets with final delay-time inlet; queues delayed messages.
objects.reference_gates: Multiple queued values, clear/flush, outlet order, typed defaults and cancellation.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Message inlet and bang outlet; emits during patch opening/initialization or on bang.
objects.reference_gates: Parent/child load order, suppression during opening and graph lifecycle.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Input messages delivered to matching named receive objects; no patchcord output.
objects.reference_gates: Namespace scope, dynamic destination, receiver delivery order and #0 expansion. Official docs explicitly say multiple-receiver reception order is nondeterministic; do not require a single global receiver order.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Receives named messages and emits through message outlet; name reassignment behavior requires reference coverage.
objects.reference_gates: Namespace lifetime, multiple receivers, ordering and name changes. Official docs explicitly say multiple-receiver reception order is nondeterministic; do not require a single global receiver order.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Left numeric/signal frequency inlet; right numeric/signal phase inlet; 1 signal output, cosine by default.
objects.reference_gates: Default phase, table interpolation, reset, buffer dependency, sample rate and vector behavior. Pd osc~ or a Faust oscillator is not an established equivalent.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Numeric input becomes constant-valued signal output.
objects.reference_gates: Initial value, numeric precision and sample-offset message application.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Left target or target/time sequence; right duration; signal ramp output and completion bang outlet. activeout adds a middle activity-signal outlet; never assume a fixed outlet count.
objects.reference_gates: Duration consumption/reset, interrupted ramps, endpoint rounding, completion timing and scheduler settings; Pd line~ is not established equivalent.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: 2 signal/numeric inputs; 1 signal output multiplies the operands.
objects.reference_gates: Unconnected inlet defaults, scalar/signal precedence, floating precision and exceptional values.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Left signal/slider-value input; right ramp-time input. Left scaled signal output, right slider integer output.
objects.reference_gates: Nonlinear slider law, range and ramp smoothing (documented default 10 ms), silent set; not a linear multiply alias.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

objects.ports: Signal inputs mapped to hardware channels by arguments; no signal outlet. Control messages affect audio lifecycle.
objects.reference_gates: Host channel mapping, lifecycle, device configuration and unavailable-host refusal.
objects.message_type_scope: Vocabulary to investigate, not a claim that every listed type is accepted by every inlet. See ports and official reference.

requirements: Preserve bang/int/float/symbol/list/anything identities and Max-specific coercion.
Model hot/cold state separately from triggering output.
Depth-first synchronous message traversal, right-to-left trigger outlets and explicit patchline order.
Unspecified patchline order is unresolved: source array order is not asserted execution order.
Bound recursion, message count, timers and cancellation; fail visibly rather than silently discard.
Capture high/low priority, overdrive, scheduler-in-audio-interrupt, signal vector and I/O vector settings.
Keep defer/deferlow, initialization, named receiver order and DSP/message boundaries unimplemented until measured.
